coverage.domain: fixed source, 0.0253 eV beam on a pure B-10 slab (optical thickness 0.9 to 2.8), 294 K

source.check: Independent of OpenMC's transport: the formula and the library cross sections only. The absorption and flux entries are tied by absorption = Sigma_a x flux.
source.text: A beam of 0.0253 eV neutrons along +x onto a 12 cm slab of pure B-10 (0.001 g/cm3, 294 K), 20000 x 10 histories, seed 12345. Expected: the beam's track length in the slab, (1 - exp(-Sigma_t t))/Sigma_t, which is also absorption / Sigma_a. Optical thickness 2.776. Cross sections (total 3846.99 b, absorption 3844.80 b) read from the library file B10.h5 (sha256 dab256fa4794...) by studio/tools/seed_oracle_xs.py. Tolerance: 4 sigma of the predicted statistical error (0.192 % per sigma) plus 0.4 % for the neglected elastic scattering (0.057 % of all collisions).
